Addendum 81: "Move transaction left of settings and move accrual rate to right of Available · swap these two": the Accrual Units card reads ACCRUAL UNITS · + Transaction (the gear’s height) · gear on line 1, and Available (left) · Accrual Rate (right) on line 2. |
